faq.a: Samra is associated with the Arabic form ثَمْرَاء, whose core sense is samra; fruitful (feminine).

faq.q: What is the origin of Samra?
faq.a: Samra is associated with Arabic. Samra is the Bosnian form of Arabic ثَمْرَاء (Thamrāʾ), the feminine of أَثْمَر, meaning 'fruitful'.
Yes — the underlying form ثَمْرَاء is Arabic.
Samra can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Samra should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Thamrāʾ is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Samra mean in Persian?

A romanized syllable approximation is sam-ra. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Samra?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Samra, samra. Script forms are ثمرا, ثمراء, ثَمْرَاء, समरा.

faq.q: Is Samra a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
